# Fudge MCP server

Fudge is a remote MCP server for design research. It gives AI coding tools real websites to study so they can make better design decisions while building.

## Connect

Add the remote server to Claude Code:

```sh
claude mcp add --transport http fudge https://api.withfudge.com/mcp
```

Or add the checked-in `.mcp.json` configuration to a Claude Code project and
start Claude Code from that project.

The server uses OAuth. When Claude Code opens the authorization page, sign in at [design.withfudge.com](https://design.withfudge.com) and approve access.

## Links

- Product: https://design.withfudge.com
- MCP documentation: https://design.withfudge.com/mcp
- MCP endpoint: https://api.withfudge.com/mcp
